explanation: Pulp Fiction won the Palme d'Or at Cannes in 1994. Before directing, Tarantino worked in a video rental shop in Manhattan Beach, California.

claims.text: Quentin Tarantino directed Pulp Fiction (1994) and Kill Bill: Volume 1 (2003).
Robert Rodriguez, Guy Ritchie and Martin Scorsese did not direct Pulp Fiction or Kill Bill.
Pulp Fiction won the Palme d'Or at the 1994 Cannes Film Festival.
Before directing, Tarantino worked at Video Archives, a video rental shop in Manhattan Beach, California.
